pairs.difference: Both whistles sit diagonally near the center with clear surrounding space. B fills slightly more of the card, but neither framing clearly departs from the references.
A reads as a horn first, with small tassels beneath it. B crowds the upper-right corner with its bell, while the large red tassels compete with the horn at thumbnail size.
pairs.fix: Reduce the red tassels and leave more space above and to the right of the bell. Keep the horn as the clear main shape.

pairs.difference: A's cup and saucer fill the center, with a short steam curl above. B places a smaller cup low on the card and gives the tall steam plume much of the upper half.
pairs.fix: Enlarge the cup and saucer and raise them toward the center. Shorten the steam to a small curl above the rim.

pairs.difference: Both baskets fill a similar central area, with clear handles above and comfortable space around their silhouettes. Neither has a clear hierarchy or framing mismatch.
Both barrels dominate the center with comparable side clearances. B reaches slightly higher, but both retain a clear barrel-first thumbnail read.
A leaves a broad blue area above the taxi. B fills more of the upper card with the roof sign and windshield while keeping the sides close to the edges, producing a more crowded silhouette.
pairs.fix: Make the taxi slightly smaller and lower it a little, leaving a wider band of blue above the roof sign.

pairs.difference: A presents one broad tent against the forest. B adds a bright lantern at lower right, visible bedding inside, and dense foreground plants, creating several competing thumbnail focal points.
pairs.fix: Keep the tent as the single main subject. Remove the foreground lantern, simplify the visible bedding, and thin the plants around the entrance.

pairs.difference: A centers a broad pot above a small fire with simple surroundings. B gives more space and emphasis to the stone fire ring, with a vegetable crate at left and a stump at right competing with the pot. The recurring departure is added peripheral emphasis that weakens the single-hero read.
pairs.fix: Remove the vegetable crate and stump. Make the fire and surrounding stones smaller and simpler, keeping the pot as the dominant central shape.

pattern: Generated cards tend to crowd the frame or add strong secondary elements that compete with the main object at thumbnail size.
